Title: DML500A
Sub Title: Created for architects and designers
Product Description:
Designed for architects, the thin design of the DML500A affords flush mounting in walls and ceilings.

Technical Table:
System integrators are specifying this radically different technology to solve room problems old-school loudspeakers worsen.

How different? The DML500A eschews pumping focused air pressure waves traditional loudspeakers employ to create ear-fatiguing sound. Instead, non-destructive waves emerge wide and diffuse to more gently bathe the ear in pleasing, super-intelligible sound over almost eight octaves.

Especially noticeable in highly reverberant spaces, DML sound waves provide non-destructive room interactions, so free of room echo and comb filtering that one customer referred to the intelligibility improvement over their old church system as “mind boggling.”

Floor-to-balcony, stereo-stable imaging in every seat is another performance “wow,” making DML500A the top choice for immersive audio.

Superb power handling plus 165° conical coverage allowed an American airport to replace 104 traditional speakers with six DML500A flat panels.

Unmatched placement flexibility also optimizes aesthetic choices and quicker installations.

Rugged construction includes a powder coated die cast aluminum frame with multiple mounting points. 200×200 VESA adapter is available for purchase separately.

DML500A is designed for custom integration into existing structures or architecture. If the desired mounting location is where it might easily be impacted by foreign objects, the carbon-fiber/Nomex panel of the DML could be damaged. Title: THEATRIX
Sub Title: FREESTANDING SPEAKER
Product Description:
Description

These 3-way extreme speakers deliver an incredibly dynamic and effortless performance. Utilising commercial cinema technology, the Theatrix are capable of producing high sound pressure levels with pristine fidelity and extremely low distortion. A dedicated midrange driver enhances performance and ensures superior vocal intelligibility.

The Theatrix are serious main front speakers for a truly serious dedicated home cinema experience.  It is a 3-way, bi-amped screen loudspeaker suitable for medium to large size rooms. The addition of a dedicated midrange section overcomes the demands placed on the high frequency component, enhancing performance.

By splitting the signal into three dedicated sections, the loudspeaker produces superior vocal intelligibility in the critical 1kHz – 3kHz speech region. It’s not often that you find smooth response, acoustic power, and dynamic range in one model of speaker, but with the Theatrix you can have it all.

The Theatrix features a 380mm high stiffness paper cone driver with a 77mm voice coil for increased linear excursion, and a powerful, vented magnet assembly designed for low distortion. Its specially engineered bass driver offers superb bass performance, high peak program power handling and high efficiency – capable of very high sound pressure levels. The massive ferrite magnet structure includes components engineered to achieve maximum efficiency.  Symmetrical gap geometry, combined with large linear voice coil travel, ensures minimum distortion at all levels.

The dedicated midrange is delivered by a Krix designed 90 by 40 degree constant directivity horn with a 77mm throat, driven by a 165mm curvilinear paper cone driver with large voice coil and neodymium magnet.

For high frequencies, the Theatrix features Krix’s patented design, a 90 by 40 short throw horn, delivering optimum dispersion of 90 degrees horizontal and 40 degrees vertical, consistently maintained over the entire working bandwidth. It is driven by a compression driver with a 25mm throat, 32mm edge-wound aluminium voice coil and Nomex former.  The constant directivity means far less sound is reflected off of side walls and ceilings, ensuring sound energy is focused directly at the listening position for better clarity.

The horn assemblies are mounted to the bass cabinet with a solid mounting bracket which offers both vertical and horizontal tilt. The electronic filter network for the horn section is housed in a separate, well-ventilated enclosure, mounted at the rear of the midrange horn. Introducing Nice Premium Toolless Speakers:  

Nice speakers are an evolution of SpeakerCraft™- the inventor of architectural speakers. Nice is proud to build upon this legacy, leveraging decades of expertise and innovation to produce some of the finest products on the market.

Innovative Solutions 


Nice SC 2

delivers high-performance for home entertainment and media. Deep anodized aluminum woofers and tweeters, Kapton former material, and an asymmetrical 3rd order crossover takes the series into the stratosphere. These lightweight and durable materials deliver low distortion, exceptional dynamics, and enhanced soundstage. Nonconductive Kapton improves magnetic field stability. The series 2 models include 6.5” down firing and fixed tilt, and 8” in-ceiling speakers, as well as a dual 5.25” in-wall speaker. The 8” model features a 1.25” tweeter! The crossover is an asymmetrical 2nd-order low pass filter on woofer 3rd-order high pass filter on tweeter, designed to optimize each driver’s performance with improved phase alignment with a 3-position tweeter level switch for fine tuning the high frequencies. Nice Premium Toolless Speakers deliver elevated audio performance with advanced materials, toolless installation, and uncompromised design. Encompassing three levels of performance across 14 models, the series delivers a solution for most architectural speaker applications. From whole home music, and media rooms, to dedicated home theaters, and even high-moisture environments like outdoor patios or bathrooms. The speakers in each level are voiced to work coherently within the range delivering a complimentary balanced and dynamic sound across all applications throughout the home. The entire range boasts a suite of innovative features and benefits. Proprietary AccuAim technology enables precise, lockable tweeter positioning for enhanced phase accuracy, XmaG extended pole pieces for improved symmetry, meticulously engineered high-end crossovers for optimized driver performance, and time saving ViseLock™ designed by Swarm- the latest generation toolless system for rapid and secure installations- up to 75% faster!



AccuAim allows the tweeter to click-lock into a fixed angle that can be precisely replicated on other speakers in the system. This improves phase accuracy to pinpoint the sweet spot, and fine tune the soundstage.



ViseLock™ designed by Swarm,allows a rapid toolless install with the benefits of a patented clamping system of spring-loaded doglegs that snap into place instantly, securing the speaker. Thumb- levered cinches, lock and hold the installation for added stability- preventing spring sag for many years of service.



Go the extra mmTraditional pole pieces allow a magnetic gap in which the voice coil leaves the primary magnetic field resulting in non linier response and distortion, especially at higher levels.



XmaGprecision pole piece extends significantly beyond the woofer’s voice coil travel path ensuring a consistent magnetic field- this results in a more linear response at all levels, lower distortion and clearer, more accurate sound reproduction. Lound AND Clear!



Metal is stronger than PlasticCustom designed metal frames are stiffer more, stable, with less transmission loss through the ceiling than typical injection molded frames.

Product Description:
Description

SC1-IC6-DT 6.5 Inch In-Ceiling Speaker With Injected Poly Woofer, Dual Voice Coil And Dual Pivoting 1 Inch Silk AccuAim Tweeters, Toolless Install.

Introducing Nice Premium Toolless Speakers:  
Nice speakers are an evolution of SpeakerCraft™- the inventor of architectural speakers. Nice is proud to build upon this legacy, leveraging decades of expertise and innovation to produce some of the finest products on the market.

Innovative Solutions 
Nice SC1 speakers are optimized for high quality ambient music, and everyday media applications throughout the home. With 6.5” injected polypropylene woofers and 1” silk dome tweeters. There are four models including down firing, fixed-tilt, dual tweeter, and all weather in-ceiling speakers. The symmetrical 2nd-order crossover network provides quality, consistency and reliability. Nice Premium Toolless Speakers deliver elevated audio performance with advanced materials, toolless installation, and uncompromised design. Encompassing three levels of performance across 14 models, the series delivers a solution for most architectural speaker applications. From whole home music, and media rooms, to dedicated home theaters, and even high-moisture environments like outdoor patios or bathrooms. The speakers in each level are voiced to work coherently within the range delivering a complimentary balanced and dynamic sound across all applications throughout the home. The entire range boasts a suite of innovative features and benefits. Proprietary AccuAim technology enables precise, lockable tweeter positioning for enhanced phase accuracy, XmaG extended pole pieces for improved symmetry, meticulously engineered high-end crossovers for optimized driver performance, and time saving ViseLock™ designed by Swarm- the latest generation toolless system for rapid and secure installations- up to 75% faster!

AccuAim 
Allows the tweeter to click-lock into a fixed angle that can be precisely replicated on other speakers in the system. This improves phase accuracy to pinpoint the sweet spot, and fine tune the soundstage.

ViseLock™ designed by Swarm
Allows a rapid toolless install with the benefits of a patented clamping system of spring-loaded doglegs that snap into place instantly, securing the speaker. Thumb- levered cinches, lock and hold the installation for added stability- preventing spring sag for many years of service.

Go the extra mm
Traditional pole pieces allow a magnetic gap in which the voice coil leaves the primary magnetic field resulting in non linier response and distortion, especially at higher levels.

XmaG
Precision pole piece extends significantly beyond the woofer’s voice coil travel path ensuring a consistent magnetic field- this results in a more linear response at all levels, lower distortion and clearer, more accurate sound reproduction. Lound AND Clear!

Metal is stronger than Plastic
Custom designed metal frames are stiffer more, stable, with less transmission loss through the ceiling than typical injection molded frames.

Rust Resistant Grills
All models include a paintable bezelless stainless-steel grill, which resists rust naturally. In-ceiling models include a round grill, with a square grill sold separately. In-wall models include a rectangular grill.

Product Description: The original Custom Install speaker brand, SpeakerCraft from the USA certainly know how to design and build great speakers. Technical Table:
Independent Chambers
The SB-40P has three speaker enclosures within the soundbar. The Left and Right chambers are vented enclosures, which are ideal for sound effects and deeper bass. The Center chamber is a highly damped sealed enclosure which produces lower group delay and more controlled excursion. The result is Center Channel dialog that is easier to understand with better music clarity and detail. The ported Left and right chambers deliver outstanding dynamics.

Premium Woofers and Tweeters
The SB-40P incorporates six injection molded graphite woofers and three titanium tweeters. The woofers use a special formulation of graphite, polypropylene, and carbon fiber materials, combining them using an injection molding process. The qualities of these different materials work together to deliver exceptionally clear mid-range, as well as the stiffness and strength required to produce strong low frequencies that blend well with any subwoofer. The one-inch titanium tweeters provide excellent transient response. Titanium was chosen for its exceptional proprieties that accurately reproduce high frequencies and rapid transients with breathtaking realism. It is light, thin and stiff, yet delicate, therefore protected with three tweeter bars. The material properties of the IMG woofer cones and titanium tweeters work together to provide a spacious, open sound stage.

Crossover Networks
The SB-40P™’s three high-quality internal crossover circuits (one per channel) are carefully tuned through measurement and subjective listening tests for outstanding room filling natural sound.

Cabinet
The cabinet is made from thick MDF panels to prevent unwanted vibration, so the sound you hear comes from just the drivers and not the cabinet. The black polymer coating helps to acoustically seal and dampen the enclosure producing a sound that seems more like itâ€™s coming from three separate speakers instead of a soundbar.

Title: PIX
Sub Title: FREESTANDING SPEAKER
Product Description:
These 2-way extreme speakers deliver an incredibly dynamic and effortless performance. Utilising commercial cinema technology, the Pix are capable of producing high sound pressure levels with pristine fidelity and extremely low distortion.

Pix are serious main front speakers for dedicated home cinemas. Providing exceptionally high acoustic power output over an extremely wide frequency range, with low harmonic distortion and excellent power handling – evident in the third harmonic, in the critical 1kHz – 3kHz speech region.  The smooth response, acoustic power and dynamic range of the Pix are features not often found in one speaker.
Technical Table:
Description

The Pix features a 380mm high stiffness paper cone driver with a 75mm (3″) voice coil for increased linear excursion, and a powerful, vented magnet assembly designed for low distortion. Its specially engineered bass driver offers superb bass performance, high peak program power handling and high efficiency – capable of very high sound pressure levels. The massive ferrite magnet structure includes components engineered to achieve maximum efficiency.  Symmetrical gap geometry, combined with large linear voice coil travel, ensures minimum distortion at all levels.

For high frequencies, the Pix features Krix’s patented design, a 90 by 40 short throw horn, delivering optimum dispersion of 90 degrees horizontal and 40 degrees vertical, consistently maintained over the entire working bandwidth. It is driven by a compression driver with a 25mm throat, featuring a 35mm (1.4″) voice coil, coated titanium diaphragm and polyimide surround.  The constant directivity means far less sound is reflected off of side walls and ceilings, ensuring sound energy is focused directly at the listening position for better clarity.

The horn assembly is mounted to the bass cabinet with a solid mounting bracket, offering both vertical and horizontal tilt, while the crossover network – housed in the bass cabinet – uses professional grade, close tolerance components, for a smooth frequency response.

Sub Title: 360° GARDEN SPEAKERS
Product Description:
The 360°SN117 garden speakers, enhanced in Corian®, are designed for outdoor listening and architectural placement. With their minimalist design and maximum power in the smallest footprint, they enrich even the most sought-after outdoor spaces. The 360-degree, natural and airy sound provides a superior listening experience.

CREATED FOR YOUR OUTDOOR SPACES

LOTO speakers are designed to deliver high-quality audio performance in outdoor spaces, thanks to their essential, geometric design. They have an optimized fastening system for swimming pools, parks, terraces and verandas. Made of Corian and available in a wide range of finishes, these diffusers blend seamlessly into any setting.

Each speaker is designed to provide superior audio performance. The natural, airy sound spreads out in all directions, minimizing the amount of speakers needed due to the acoustic lens and the optimal ratio of power to footprint. The speakers, designed by Garvan and manufactured in Italy, are individually tested to ensure the highest quality.

ROBUSTNESS

Title: SA255-MKII
Sub Title: Monaural Subwoofer Amplifier
Product Description:
SA255-MKII Monaural Subwoofer Amplifier

The SA255-MKII is an integrated monaural subwoofer amplifier and crossover system designed as a low-distortion power source for Stealth Acoustics invisible subwoofer panels and other un-powered subwoofers. The rack-mount chassis combines variable low-pass filtering, fixed subsonic filtering and high current output for clean, controlled bass in home audio and home-theater systems.

  • 250 watts into 8 ohm, 350 watts into 4 ohm (both less than 0.05% THD)

  • Total harmonic distortion below 0.05% at 1 watt

  • Signal-to-noise ratio 86 dB below rated output

  • Variable low-pass: 50 Hz to 150 Hz at 18 dB/octave with bypass

  • Fixed high-pass (subsonic) filter: 18 Hz at 30 dB/octave

  • 19 in W x 3-1/2 in H x 13-5/8 in D, 31.3 lb

  • Selectable 115 / 230 VAC operation

Black anodized aluminum finish and a single-rack-unit footprint make it easy to integrate into any equipment rack.
Thumbnail:alt: Stealth Acoustics SA 255 MKII amplifier

Title: LS1
Sub Title:
6 1/2" woofer with neo magnet
2x1" horn loaded dome tweeter
Product Description:
LS1 is the number one choice for demanding Home Theatre or dedicated Home Cinema applications where very high output and clarity is needed from a very compact speaker. The dual tweeter arrangement gives extra headroom in the mid-highs with horn-like dynamics while maintaining the sweetness and clarity of a silk dome. 
Drive units in the LS1 have been designed by the finest European manufacturers. The 6 1/2″ woofer features a strong neodymium magnet with state-of-the art-cooling and less than 1,8 dB power compression after 8 hours of maximum SPL. The result is a loudspeaker with a truely remarkable dynamic range. 

​The closely spaced 1″ horn-loaded dome tweeter in the LS1 offers excellent throw and enables it effortlessly to transmit voices to the rear seats. The extruded aluminium cabinet is well dampened and the triangular shape minimises standing waves inside the cabinet. LS1 offers top quality sound reproduction for demanding Home Cinema applications.

Title: AIR-S12 IP
Sub Title: Weather-resistant 12-inch installation subwoofer
Product Description:
Weather-resistant 12-inch install sub

The AIR-S12 IP is the IP54-rated version of MAG Audio's compact AIR-S12 installation subwoofer. Engineered to extend the AIR series down into the low end, it brings tight, install-friendly bass to fixed systems indoors and out.

  • 12-inch woofer with 3-inch voice coil

Title: AIR-C5T
Sub Title: 5.25-inch Hi-Z (70V / 100V) installation speaker
Product Description:
5.25-inch install speaker with 70V / 100V line input

The AIR-C5T is the transformer (Hi-Z) version of the compact AIR-C5 installation cabinet. A 5.25-inch woofer plus a 1-inch carbon-fibre HF on a rotatable horn covers 100 x 70 degrees, while built-in 70V / 100V tap settings make distributed-system wiring straightforward.

  • 5.25-inch woofer with 1.25-inch voice coil

  • 1-inch carbon-fibre HF with neodymium magnet on a rotatable horn

  • 70 W nominal power, 119.5 dB Max SPL

  • Compatible with 70V / 100V lines and 16 Ohm Lo-Z connections

  • VESA 50 x 50 plus M10 safety point; IP54 weather rating

At 160 x 277 x 157 mm and 4.1 kg, the AIR-C5T fits ceiling, wall, vertical and horizontal mounts in restaurants, retail, hospitality, fitness studios and outdoor terraces where 70V / 100V distribution is the standard.

Sub Title: On-wall cinema speaker with 15deg angled baffle for surround duty
Product Description:
Cinema surround impact, on the wall.

The Megaphonix is engineered for on-wall use in dedicated home cinemas, with high power handling and high-sensitivity drivers optimised for surround sound effects. A 15-degree angled front baffle aims output toward the listening area when mounted as side or rear surrounds.

  • 255mm paper-cone bass driver with 50mm voice coil for low distortion

  • 26mm doped fabric dome tweeter on a 90 deg x 40 deg waveguide for consistent dispersion

  • Braced, critically-damped cabinet with rear key-hook mounts and black grille

The Megaphonix slots into a five-speaker family, allowing matched timbre across in-room, in-wall and on-wall positions.

Concert-quality background music in your backyard.

The Aquatix delivers concert-quality background music outdoors, built to withstand Australia's harshest conditions. UV-stabilised polymer cabinets, marine-grade stainless steel hardware and an aluminium grille resist corrosion year-round.

  • 130mm polypropylene bass driver with rubber surround

  • 22mm ferro-fluid-cooled mylar dome tweeter for smooth highs

Available in white or black with a five-year warranty - a confident choice for patios, eaves and entertaining areas.

LR8g Invisible 2-Way Loudspeaker (Legacy)

The LR8g is a 2-way, full-range invisible loudspeaker (superseded by the 8th-generation LR224) designed for in-wall or in-ceiling mounting. A rigid frame attaches to standard structural framing and a paintable active diaphragm face takes paint, wallpaper or fabric so the loudspeaker becomes completely invisible after installation.

The LR8g remains a workhorse for replacements and matching existing LineaResponse-based installations.

Title: NEUPHONIX MK2
Sub Title: Floorstanding
Product Description:
For the ultimate experience look no further. Delivering striking clarity and power, this 3-way design pairs with the matching Epicentrix Mk2 for the ultimate front soundstage.

A big sound for your biggest space, whether playing the latest blockbuster movie or an album to rock the room. The Neuphonix Mk2 can handle the power, cooly, calmly, without taking up too much space.

With a sculpted front baffle designed to improve clarity, the Neuphonix Mk2 is a 3-way design featuring four custom-designed 130mm bass drivers, each with oversized magnets.

An extensive crossover network – featuring only low tolerance, high grade components – beautifully matches the 130mm dedicated midrange and the high grade 26mm ring radiator tweeter, delivering an extended frequency response to 40kHz.

A scalloped grille subtly augments the acoustic benefits of the baffle and adds extra style to an already streamlined design, while there is also beauty from behind, with a brushed aluminium terminal plate and gold plated brass binding posts. Complete the look with your choice of premium cabinet finishes. Elegance is in the details.

For the ultimate sound experience at home, play it through Krix.

Tailor-made acoustic panels with integrated loudspeaker

CinemAtelier combines Atelier acoustic panels, a product of high-quality, Made in Italy manufacture, with the high fidelity of Garvan loudspeakers. The acoustic sound panels can be installed next to or under the TV and they feature integrated speakers, for a customised sound solution.

CinemAtelier™ panels are tailor-made, to perfectly adapt to the size of any kind of screen, guaranteeing an unparalleled acoustic and aesthetic result. Perfect integration and ease of installation are two fundamental elements distinguishing the collection.

The fabric covering the surface also covers the side surfaces and adds to the product a sartorial effect, particularly suitable for interior design. CinemAtelier™ is available in a wide range of finishes, colors, and custom graphics. The fireproof acoustic fabric in Trevira CS yarn offers a velvety tactile experience and is similar to cotton.

CinemAtelier™ allows reducing indoor noise and reverberation, thus offering the guests an improved and pleasant acoustic experience. Thanks to the soundproofing features of the panels combined with the high-quality sound of the integrated speakers, CinemAtelier™ will let you experience intense emotions like you were at the cinema.

Title: IP-SW-24P-10
Sub Title: 24-port pre-configured PoE+ switch for Netvio AVoIP
Product Description:
The Netvio IP-SW-24P-10 is a 24-port Gigabit PoE+ managed switch that is pre-configured at the factory for Netvio JP4 AVoIP deployments. Installers simply plug encoders, decoders and the IP-JP4-CL-10 controller into the appropriate ports - all VLAN, IGMP, multicast and jumbo-frame settings are already in place.

  • Factory Pre-Configured — Ready for Netvio JP4 encoders, decoders, and controllers with zero IT programming.

  • High PoE Power — 450 W PoE budget sufficient for all connected JP4 devices.

  • Dedicated Controller Ports — Optimized for Netvio IP-JP4-CL-10 central controller integration.

  • Rackmount Form Factor — Professional 1U chassis designed for 24/7 reliability.

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.
Thumbnail:alt: NETVIO 24-port network switch with PoE

Title: IC-52
Sub Title: Angled-baffle in-ceiling speaker for clearer off-axis imaging
Product Description:
A more three-dimensional soundstage from the ceiling.

The IC-52 features a 20-degree angled baffle that aims sound toward the listening area, reducing wall reflections for a clearer experience and more three-dimensional soundstage. Separate front-mounted bass and tweeter drivers give it hi-fi performance to rival Krix bookshelf speakers.

  • 130mm doped curvilinear paper cone bass driver with copper shorting ring

  • 26mm ring radiator tweeter on dedicated mount for clean dispersion

  • Slim paintable magnetic stainless-steel grille (white or black)

Tonally matched across Krix's home entertainment range, the IC-52 is an architectural answer for serious distributed audio.

Title: Stingray 6
Product Description:
Stingray 6 Compact Outdoor Loudspeaker

The Stingray 6 is the smallest member of the Stingray series, a 2-way full-range outdoor loudspeaker designed for distributed audio and background music. A 6.5 in woofer and high-frequency driver behind Stealth's FidelityGlass radiating surface combine direct-coupled motor and acoustic-lever technology to produce crisp highs and impactful bass in a compact, weather-proof package.

  • 2-way passive crossover with 6.5 in woofer

  • 50 Hz to 18 kHz frequency response

  • 120 watts RMS capacity, 60 watts minimum recommended

  • 83 dB sensitivity, 8 ohm nominal impedance

  • 170 degrees horizontal and vertical dispersion

  • IP-68 environmental rating; operates 0 to 150 deg F

Ideal for residential, commercial and marine outdoor installations where Stingray-grade durability is needed in a smaller footprint.
Thumbnail:alt: Black speaker, front and back view, with StingRay6 logo.

Title: Tropix
Sub Title: All-weather outdoor speaker with extended bass and high sensitivity
Product Description:
Big enclosure, big bass, big tweeter.

The Tropix is an all-weather outdoor speaker built for entertaining. A larger enclosure, 165mm bass driver and 26mm damped mylar dome tweeter combine to give extended bass and high sensitivity well beyond what most outdoor speakers can muster.

  • Marine-grade, UV-stabilised all-weather enclosure with stainless hardware

  • Internal reinforcing ribs minimise panel resonance for cleaner output

  • Corrosion-resistant mounting bracket and aluminium grille

Backed by a five-year warranty and ideal for patios, pool houses and alfresco zones where music quality matters.
Thumbnail:alt: Black KSIX speaker with logo

Title: AIR-S15 IP
Sub Title: Weather-resistant 15-inch installation subwoofer
Product Description:
Weather-resistant 15-inch install sub

The AIR-S15 IP is the IP54 version of MAG Audio's AIR-S15 installation subwoofer. A single 15-inch driver with a 4-inch voice coil delivers controlled low end for permanent install systems, while the weather-resistant cabinet keeps the box working through outdoor seasons.

  • 15-inch woofer with 4-inch voice coil

  • 1000 W nominal power, 136 dB Max SPL

  • 37 - 300 Hz frequency response (-10 dB)

  • 4 / 8 Ohm switchable impedance

  • Phoenix connector with IP54 enclosure

At 36 kg in a 700 x 527 x 417 mm cabinet, the AIR-S15 IP is a workhorse low-end companion for outdoor terraces, hospitality, leisure venues and retail builds.

Title: Equinox Mk5
Sub Title: Compact 2-way bookshelf that punches well above its size
Product Description:
A big sound from a small speaker.

The Equinox Mk5 is a compact bookshelf speaker engineered to be tucked away while still filling the room with sound. A 130mm cast-aluminium woofer with doped paper cone partners with a 26mm dual-concentric ring radiator tweeter for refined, articulate playback.

  • Rear-vented bass reflex enclosure for balanced low-end response

  • 45Hz-40kHz in-room response and 88dB sensitivity

  • Doubles as a stand-mounted surround in multi-channel systems

Whether you're building a stereo rig or finishing off a 5.1/7.1 setup, the Equinox Mk5 delivers performance well beyond its modest footprint.

Title: BEE-15
Sub Title: Passive portable 15-inch coaxial speaker
Product Description:
BEE-15 is a passive FOH and stage monitoring speaker featuring a 15 in coaxial driver with a 3 in voice coil. Connects via industry-standard Speakon for simple integration into sound reinforcement setups, with flytrack and pole mount options.

  • 15 in coaxial driver, 97 dB sensitivity, 136 dB max SPL

  • 80 x 80 degrees coverage, 500 W nominal power

  • M10 fly points, 35mm pole socket, M10 safety point
Thumbnail:alt: Black powered speaker with metal grill

Title: AIR-C4
Sub Title: Compact 4-inch passive installation speaker
Product Description:
The smallest box in the AIR-C family

The AIR-C4 is the most compact system in the AIR-C installation series, with a 4-inch woofer and a high-frequency driver mounted on a rotatable horn. The cabinet is IP54-rated for indoor or outdoor permanent installs and ships with VESA 50 x 50 plus a safety mounting point.

  • 4-inch woofer with 1-inch voice coil

  • 1-inch carbon-fibre HF diaphragm on a rotatable horn

  • 50 W nominal, 117 dB Max SPL, 16 Ohm impedance

  • 100° x 70° rotatable coverage

  • VESA 50 x 50 plus safety point; IP54 weather rating

At 146 x 260 x 154 mm and only 2.7 kg, the AIR-C4 is built for ceilings and walls in cafes, retail, fitness studios and small foyers - anywhere the speaker should disappear visually but stay tonally even.

Unmatched high fidelity in a smaller package.

  • One pivoting 1" liquid-cooled treated silk dome tweeter

  • Ported enclosure that enhances low-frequency response

Built for the outdoors

  • Drivers made from space-age polymers, injection-molded graphite or aluminum for sonic purity

  • Timbre-matched across all three Outdoor Elements series speakers

  • 4 Ohm impedance with 125W power handling

Title: ISP Evo
Sub Title: FULLY DIGITAL IMMERSIVE SOUND PROCESSOR
Product Description:
Description

The ISP Evo is the first purely digital immersive sound processor on the home cinema market. Built on a fully digital signal path with AES/EBU and AoIP (AES67/Dante) interfaces, it is the only processor capable of interfacing directly with Digital Cinema Processors playing DCP content and delivering up to 32 channels in digital format over the network.

Up to 32 channels of decoding and upmixing handle every major immersive format — Dolby Atmos, DTS:X Pro, Auro-3D, IMAX Enhanced, MPEG-H and Sony 360 Reality Audio — with up to 32 channels of post-processing. HDMI 2.1 with HDCP 2.3 supports 8K/40 Gbps, HDR10+, Dolby Vision and HLG pass-through across all seven inputs and two eARC outputs.

Dirac Live Room Correction, Dirac Live Bass Control and Dirac Live Active Room Treatment all ship as standard, paired with StormAudio's Expert Bass Management for full-range reference performance in the most demanding installations.

Title: OWX-55
Sub Title: Vertical on-wall cinema speaker with wide-range adjustable bracket
Product Description:
Tall, slim, and aimed exactly where you need it.

The OWX-55 takes the same patented constant-directivity horn and dual 6.5" driver array as the OWX-50 and reorganises them into a taller, slimmer cabinet. The bracket flushes flat or angles up to 68 degrees, making it ideal for high screen-channel or overhead positions.

  • Dual 165mm paper-cone drivers and 1" compression driver on a patented horn

  • Adjustable bracket from flush to 68 degrees for precise on-axis aim

  • 97dB sensitivity with 50-500W RMS handling for cinema-grade output

Compact, sleek and supplied with an integrated grille, the OWX-55 disappears into the architecture while delivering ultra-consistent dispersion.

Title: SA314
Sub Title:
Left, Center, Right
ACOUSTIC SOUND PANELS
Product Description:
The acoustic sound panels with integrated speaker CinemAtelier™ are part of the collection Architectural Acoustic Solution. The collection is the result of 15 years of constant acoustic innovation, aiming at offering the best acoustic comfort solution to any environment.

Tailor-made acoustic panels with integrated loudspeaker

CinemAtelier combines Atelier acoustic panels, a product of high-quality, Made in Italy manufacture, with the high fidelity of Garvan loudspeakers. The acoustic sound panels can be installed next to or under the TV and they feature integrated speakers, for a customised sound solution.

Tailor-made acoustic solutions for your TV

CinemAtelier™ panels are tailor-made, to perfectly adapt to the size of any kind of screen, guaranteeing an unparalleled acoustic and aesthetic result. Perfect integration and ease of installation are two fundamental elements distinguishing the collection.

Italian craftsmanship and high customisation possibilities

CinemAtelier™ acoustic sound panels are characterized by the excellent quality of Italian craftsmanship. The fabric covering the surface also covers the side surfaces and adds to the product a sartorial effect, particularly suitable for interior design. CinemAtelier™ is available in a wide range of finishes, colors, and custom graphics. The fireproof acoustic fabric in Trevira CS yarn offers a velvety tactile experience and is similar to cotton.

CinemAtelier™ allows reducing indoor noise and reverberation, thus offering the guests an improved and pleasant acoustic experience. Thanks to the soundproofing features of the panels combined with the high-quality sound of the integrated speakers, CinemAtelier™ will let you experience intense emotions like you were at the cinema.

One speaker, indoors or out.

The IC-20 is a versatile dual-concentric in-ceiling speaker built for both indoor and outdoor use. Weather-resistant materials and a rust-resistant stainless steel grille suit eaves and alfresco areas, while a shallow 86mm depth fits tight ceiling cavities.

Backed by a five-year warranty and built to deliver uniform coverage in all directions, the IC-20 is a workhorse for whole-home and outdoor background music.

Title: LR6G
Sub Title: LINEAR RESPONSE - INVISIBLE SPEAKERS
Product Description:
LR6g Invisible In-Wall / In-Ceiling Speaker

The LR6g is a 2-way, full-range invisible speaker that disappears into the wall or ceiling after installation. A rigid frame attaches to standard structural framing and a paintable active diaphragm face takes any finish from latex paint to light wallpaper, leaving no visible grille or trim.

  • 6.5 in woofer with 1.5 in voice coil and 15 oz ceramic magnet

  • 1-1/8 in (30 mm) neodymium high-frequency motor

  • 45 Hz to 20 kHz frequency response, 100 watts RMS

  • 83 dB sensitivity, 8 ohm nominal impedance

  • 170 degrees vertical and horizontal dispersion

  • Two independent self-resetting protection circuits

Title: Sub 18 IP
Sub Title: Weather-resistant 18-inch passive subwoofer
Product Description:
The Sub 18 IP is a single-18 vented passive subwoofer with weather resistance for outdoor deployment, delivering serious low end in mobile and fixed installs.

  • Single 18-inch vented passive subwoofer

  • Weather-resistant (IP) enclosure

  • M10 / install-friendly
Thumbnail:alt: Black speaker cabinet with MAG logo

Title: S218
Sub Title: Flagship dual-18-inch vented subwoofer
Product Description:
The S218 is MAG Audio's flagship dual-18 vented subwoofer, compatible with MAG's Uni-Preset technology so it pairs out-of-the-box with any MAG Audio speaker.

  • Flagship dual 18-inch vented subwoofer

  • Uni-Preset compatibility with the MAG range
Thumbnail:alt: Black speaker cabinet with honeycomb grilles

Title: LRX-85
Sub Title: LINEAR RESPONSE - INVISIBLE SPEAKERS
Product Description:
LRX-85 Premium 3-Way Invisible Speaker System

The LRX-85 is a premium, 3-way, two-panel invisible loudspeaker system that delivers a complete full-range solution without requiring bass-limiting filters or external subwoofers. Seven precision drivers split between a high-mid panel and a low-frequency panel produce up to 105 dB output, ideal for home theater LCR duty, distributed audio and critical-listening rooms where visible speakers are not acceptable.

  • 3-way, two-panel architecture (HM + LF)

  • One 1 in neodymium HF, four 1-1/8 in neodymium MR motors

  • Two 8 in low-profile woofers

  • 35 Hz to 20 kHz frequency response, 300 watts RMS capacity

  • 84 dB sensitivity, 8 ohm nominal impedance

  • 170 degrees horizontal and vertical dispersion

  • Three independent self-resetting protection circuits

Both panels finish flush to the wallboard and accept paint or light finish to disappear entirely once installed.

Title: EX-HT2-401-10
Sub Title: 4K30 / 1080p60 HDBaseT extender set
Product Description:
The Netvio EX-HT2-401-10 is a compact HDMI over HDBaseT extender set, supporting 4K30 video up to 40 m and 1080p60 up to 70 m over a single Cat5e/6 cable. It is the entry-level point in the Netvio HDBaseT range and is aimed at residential and light-commercial AV runs.

  • PoC (Power over Cable) – only one unit requires power

  • This allows control signals to be sent from the source to the display—and vice versa—enabling full system control from either end of the extender link.

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.

Title: SC-IC3
Sub Title: High-performance 3.5-inch small-aperture in-ceiling speaker
Product Description:
Dynamic, impactful sound in a compact, design-friendly form factor.

The SC-IC3 High Performance 3.5" In-Ceiling Speaker delivers dynamic and impactful sound in a compact package. Leveraging advanced technology and materials, its high-excursion carbon fiber woofer, proportionately massive aluminum tweeter, and custom crossover design make it a top choice for premium performance without compromising aesthetics. Both round and square grilles are included, with optional flush mount kits, to satisfy the most fastidious designers needs.

  • 3.5" carbon fiber woofer for transparent, low-distortion sound

  • 1" aluminum tweeter for dynamic detail at a lower crossover point

  • Custom crossover with proprietary Capacitor Filter/Boost Circuitry for rich bass

  • 4.75" cut-out size for quick retrofit installs with a standard hole saw

Designed as a system

  • Engineered in tandem with the SC-IC-SUB8 Small Aperture in-ceiling subwoofer

  • Includes two low-profile, paintable round and square grilles

An optional flush mount mudbank lets the grille sit flush with the surface for a near-invisible aesthetic.
Thumbnail:alt: Black speaker with red accent on white background.

Title: SC3-IC8
Sub Title: Series 3 8-inch toolless in-ceiling speaker with AccuAim tweeter
Product Description:
Reference-grade in-ceiling sound with deep, powerful bass.

The Nice SC3-IC8 is the largest single-woofer model in the flagship Series 3 line, pairing an 8 inch black Kevlar woofer with an oversized aluminum/magnesium dome tweeter for the deepest low-end and highest output in the family. It is engineered for premium home theaters and elevated listening spaces.

  • 8 inch black Kevlar woofer reaching down to 36 Hz for powerful, articulate bass

  • Proportionally massive 1 1/4 inch (30mm) aluminum/magnesium dome tweeter lowers the crossover point for exceptional imagery

  • XMag longer pole piece ensures precise linearity and accurate reproduction

AccuAim and ViseLock technologies

  • Proprietary AccuAim aiming enables precise, lockable tweeter positioning for enhanced phase accuracy

  • ViseLock toolless mounting system designed by Swarm enables installs up to 75% faster than conventional systems

  • Electroplated painted steel grill resists rust and is paintable to match any ceiling

Available in dual-tweeter (DT) and TILT variants and compatible with the optional FRBC-UNI 1-hour fire-rated cover. Backed by a 5 year warranty.
Thumbnail:alt: Circular speaker with two tweeters and a woofer

Title: WASP-8i
Sub Title: Dual 8-inch passive install line array module
Product Description:
WASP-8i is an installation line array module based on dual 8 in woofers with a 1.4 in throat HF driver. A compact line array speaker designed for venues ranging from small clubs to concert halls, delivering significant power with numerous mounting options.

  • 2 x 8 in LF drivers with 1.4 in throat HF

  • 138 dB max SPL, interchangeable 100 / 70 degrees H coverage

  • 600 W LF / 100 W HF, 16 Ohm both channels
Thumbnail:alt: Black rectangular speaker with honeycomb grille

Title: EL-ITP2-8
Sub Title: 8-inch interactive touch panel with voice control and face recognition
Product Description:
A fully interactive 8-inch touch panel for a personalized home experience.

The EL-ITP2-8 panel elevates any Nice Home Management system with a personalized experience for individual users within the home. Integrate intelligent touch panels throughout a home for convenient access to adjust lights, climates, shades, turn on music, see and speak to guests at the front door, view live or recorded surveillance footage, monitor indoor air quality, power, water, and more.

  • 8" diagonal LCD capacitive touchscreen with edge-to-edge glass and 1920 x 1200 resolution

  • Integrated microphone array extends voice control for Nice systems

  • Private, secure face recognition via the panel camera for a personal experience

Flexible installation

  • Mounts into drywall, brick, stone, plaster, and wood using a standard 2g U.S. junction box

  • Portrait or landscape mounting with proximity sensor wake

  • Plug and play operation with Nice software, available in white or black bezel

A library of background themes plus the ability to import personal photos lets users fully customize their touch panel.
Technical Table:
Experience the intelligent home with the Nice EL-ITP-8 Intelligent Touch Panel. The EL-ITP-8 elevates the experience of any gSC or g1 Nice system by using face recognition to personalize the experience for individual users. And with integrated voice assistant technology, this control panel is fully interactive, unlocking the power of intelligent home control.

With edge to edge glass and a 1920 x 1200 resolution, this intelligent interface is elegantly designed to have a low profile on the wall while providing a rich Nice user experience. Whether through face recognition or the wave of the hand. EL-ITP-8 8" Intelligent Touch Panel With Face Recognition and Voice Control The EL-ITP-8 is designer-friendly as well. The panel is equally at home in both a horizontal and a vertical orientation, allowing it to be located in almost any area that would accommodate a 2-gang wall plate. And the EL-ITP-8 is easy and flexible to install.

Title: IP-JP4-60-RX-10
Sub Title: 4K60 4:4:4 AVoIP decoder (JP4-60 series)
Product Description:
The Netvio IP-JP4-60-RX-10 is the matching 4K60 4:4:4 AVoIP decoder for the JP4-60 series. It receives uncompressed UHD HDR video from any JP4-60 encoder over 1 Gbps Ethernet, drives a 4K HDMI 2.0b display, and supports video-wall, multiview and seamless fast-switching modes with sub-frame latency.

Enhanced compatibility mode ideal conference hubs, laptop & commercial display integration.

The decoder accepts uncompressed JP4-60 video over a standard 1 Gbps Ethernet link, drives a 4K HDMI 2.0b display, and supports video-wall, multiview, picture-in-picture and seamless fast-switching modes with sub-frame latency. PoE powering means a single Cat6 cable provides both data and power back to the network switch. Like every Netvio decoder it is configured and routed from Netvio360 and exposed to end users through NetvioGo, with optional driver support for third-party controllers including Crestron, Control4, ELAN and RTI.

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.
Thumbnail:alt: Black rack mount panel with many slots. NETVIO logo.

Title: IP-JP4-CL-10
Sub Title: Central controller for Netvio JP4 AVoIP systems
Product Description:
The IP-JP4-CL-10 is Netvio’s centralised dual-network controller designed for scalable JP4 AVoIP systems. Provides independent AV and control LANs, system synchronisation, discovery, firmware management and secure enterprise-grade deployment.

  • Large-System Ready – Optimized to manage hundreds of endpoints across enterprise-scale, multi-switch networks.

  • Mass Setup & Configuration – Automatically discovers and configures all connected devices in seconds.

  • Advanced Enterprise Security – Features encrypted communications and secure device authentication to protect system integrity.

  • PoE Powered – Standard power option via PoE (802.3af Class 3); 12V DC input also supported (PSU not included).

  • Rack-Ready – Fully compatible with the Netvio IP-RK-10 rack mount kit for impeccable rack presentation.

  • Unified Control – Seamless integration with Netvio360, NetvioGo, and AppBuilder for system and end-user management.

  • Compatible with Traditional Control Systems – Drivers available for Crestron, Q-SYS, and more.

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.
Thumbnail:alt: Back panel with ports: DC 12V, AV LAN (PoE), CONTROL LAN, RS-232, IO ports, VOUT, IO LEVEL, IR IN.

Title: EX-USB3-100-10
Sub Title: USB 3.2 Gen 1 (5 Gbps) extender over fibre (100m)
Product Description:
The Netvio EX-USB3-100-10 is a USB 3.2 Gen 1 (5 Gbps) extender that reaches up to 100 m over fibre. It is designed for high-bandwidth USB peripherals - 4K webcams, document cameras, capture devices, mass storage and KVM stations - where the host and the peripheral need to live on opposite sides of a building.

  • USB 3.2 Gen 1 SuperSpeed Extension – Delivers full 5 Gbps USB performance up to 100 m (331 ft) over Cat6, Cat6aA (70 m over Cat6).

  • Plug & Play Simplicity – No drivers or software required; hardware acceleration ensures stable performance across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

  • Flexible Power Options – Dual-mode PoC design allows power from either the transmitter (TX) or receiver (RX) with the included 24 V / 2 A PSU.

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.

Title: OE6-Three

Product Description:

The Nice OE6 Three Outdoor Elements speaker addresses a multitude of exterior applications and is available in black or white. A single 6.5" aluminum cone woofer loaded into a ported enclosure dramatically enhances low-frequency response for deep, full bass that complements any type of music.

  • One pivoting 1" liquid-cooled aluminum dome tweeter

  • Ported enclosure that enhances low-frequency response

Built for the outdoors

  • Drivers made from space-age polymers, injection-molded graphite or aluminum for sonic purity

  • Timbre-matched across all three Outdoor Elements series speakers

Sub Title: Downlight-sized in-ceiling speaker for invisible whole-home audio

Music, distributed seamlessly and invisibly.

  • Twist-and-lock mounting system for fast installation

  • Paintable trim and grille blend into any ceiling colour

Title: SC-OG-6
Sub Title: 6-inch 2-way outdoor landscape satellite speaker
Product Description:
Bold outdoor performance with long-lasting durability.

The Nice SC-OG-6 brings the bold audio performance of Nice architectural speakers to outdoor spaces of all sizes. Its 6" driver and compact satellite form factor blend into any landscape while delivering the Nice signature sound across the backyard.

  • Weather-resistant fiberglass-reinforced ABS enclosure built to withstand harsh climates

  • 110-degree wide sound dispersion from a 2-way design for clear, even coverage

  • 8 Ohm or 70V/100V operation for flexible system scaling

Versatile installation

  • Selectable 70V/100V tap settings allow individual volume control of every speaker

  • Quick-connect stake, surface and conduit mounting accessories available (sold separately)

  • Rugged enough to stand up to outdoor garden equipment, including weed whackers

A complete landscape audio solution that pairs with Nice in-ground subwoofers for full-range outdoor sound.

Title: IP-JP4-60-TX-10
Sub Title: 4K60 4:4:4 AVoIP encoder (JP4-60 series)
Product Description:
The Netvio IP-JP4-60-TX-10 is a 4K60 4:4:4 AVoIP encoder in the JP4-60 series. It delivers genuinely uncompromised UHD HDR video over standard 1 Gbps Ethernet with sub-frame latency, dual ContentPlus+ low-bandwidth secondary streams for previews and recording, and license-inclusive integration with Netvio360 and NetvioGo control software.

The encoder accepts an HDMI 2.0b 18 Gbps input, supports HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision and HLG, and delivers ContentPlus+ low-bandwidth secondary streams suitable for previews, multi-view dashboards and recording. PoE powering means a single Cat6 cable supplies both data and power back to the network switch, and a local HDMI loop output makes commissioning straightforward. As with every Netvio endpoint, deployment is plug-and-play once the unit is paired to a Netvio-validated AV switch, with all configuration handled from the Netvio360 console and end-user control delivered through NetvioGo.

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.

Title: STING 6Qi
Sub Title: Subcompact 6-inch coaxial installation point-source speaker
Product Description:
Subcompact coaxial point source for fixed installs

The STING 6Qi is a subcompact installation point-source loudspeaker that combines a 6-inch coaxial driver with advanced distortion reduction in a small, install-friendly cabinet. It is designed for clean, high-output performance in retail, club and leisure builds.

  • 6-inch coaxial driver with low-distortion design

  • 150 W nominal power, 124.8 dB Max SPL

  • Wide 100° x 100° coverage from a 200 mm cube

  • 8 / 16 Ohm impedance options for distributed systems

  • VESA mounting points on the rear panel; Phoenix connector

At just 4.4 kg and 200 x 210 x 200 mm, the STING 6Qi gives integrators a high-SPL coaxial point source that still tucks into tight architectural spaces and bracket-mounts to walls and ceilings easily.

Title: SC3-IC6-TILT
Sub Title: Premium Toolless Architectural Speaker
Product Description:
Nice SC3 delivers outstanding performance and flexibility with six models, all featuring black Kevlar woofers, and 1.25 “aluminum magnesium tweeters, which are 56.3% larger than their 1” cousins. This results in more power at a lower crossover point, enhanced off-axis power response, and low- distortion. Kevlar is thin, stiff and light weight which improves transient response and dynamics, aluminum magnesium alloy has superior dampening properties, rigidity and strength- delivering impeccable detail. SC3 introduces a copper shorting ring (Faraday shield) into the design, which helps reduce distortion, improve efficiency while achieving a more consistent impedance across the frequency range. The asymmetrical crossover with a 3rd-order network encompassing 2nd-order LPF on woofer and 3rd-order HFP on the tweeter ensures superior integration between the woofer and tweeter. Compensation for inter driver time delay. A three- position tweeter level switch for fine tuning the high frequencies, and two position voice switch to allow fine tuning of the soundstage and vocal focus to taste. This combination is typical in high-end audiophile speakers, and yields an exceptional crisp, clear and dynamic musical performance. Nice Premium Toolless Speakers deliver elevated audio performance with advanced materials, toolless installation, and uncompromised design. Encompassing three levels of performance across 14 models, the series delivers a solution for most architectural speaker applications. From whole home music, and media rooms, to dedicated home theaters, and even high-moisture environments like outdoor patios or bathrooms. The speakers in each level are voiced to work coherently within the range delivering a complimentary balanced and dynamic sound across all applications throughout the home. The entire range boasts a suite of innovative features and benefits. Proprietary AccuAim technology enables precise, lockable tweeter positioning for enhanced phase accuracy, XmaG extended pole pieces for improved symmetry, meticulously engineered high-end crossovers for optimized driver performance, and time saving ViseLock™ designed by Swarm- the latest generation toolless system for rapid and secure installations- up to 75% faster!

AccuAim allows the tweeter to click-lock into a fixed angle that can be precisely replicated on other speakers in the system. This improves phase accuracy to pinpoint the sweet spot, and fine tune the soundstage.

ViseLock™ designed by Swarm, allows a rapid toolless install with the benefits of a patented clamping system of spring-loaded doglegs that snap into place instantly, securing the speaker. Thumb- levered cinches, lock and hold the installation for added stability- preventing spring sag for many years of service.

Go the extra mmTraditional pole pieces allow a magnetic gap in which the voice coil leaves the primary magnetic field resulting in non linier response and distortion, especially at higher levels.

XmaG precision pole piece extends significantly beyond the woofer’s voice coil travel path ensuring a consistent magnetic field- this results in a more linear response at all levels, lower distortion and clearer, more accurate sound reproduction. Lound AND Clear!

Metal is stronger than PlasticCustom designed metal frames are stiffer more, stable, with less transmission loss through the ceiling than typical injection molded frames.

Rust Resistant GrillsAll models include a paintable bezelless stainless-steel grill, which resists rust naturally. In-ceiling models include a round grill, with a square grill sold separately. In-wall models include a rectangular grill.

The sound is natural, light and spreads in all directions minimising the number of speakers required, thanks to the acoustic lens and the maximum ratio between power and size. Garvan-designed outdoor subwoofers are 100% Made in Italy and feature state-of-the-art electronic components. Plus, every and each loudspeaker is individually tested.

Title: FT600SIP
Sub Title: Doorphone entry outdoor station, no camera, no keypad
Product Description: The FT600SIP is a standalone outdoor station with 2 usable SIP accounts that can be activated simultaneously. FT600W monitors and FT600APP smartphone apps can be ordered for this outpost in addition to using the 2nd SIP account. The outpost has one push button. The supplied black-anodized housing allows on- and flush-mounting (216x116mm).

Title: AIR-82
Sub Title: Compact passive 8-inch coaxial installation loudspeaker
Product Description:
The passive installation speaker AIR-82 is extremely compact, featuring an 8-inch coaxial woofer. The model has numerous mounting options, providing usability for each and every project.

  • 8-inch coaxial driver with 94 dB sensitivity and 127 dB max SPL

  • 90 x 90 degrees coverage with 4/8/16 Ohm impedance options

  • VESA 75 x 75, dual M10 fly points, and M10 safety point
Thumbnail:alt: Black speaker with honeycomb grille and golden logo

Title: HORNET 12
Sub Title: Three-way touring line array module
Product Description:
The HORNET 12 is a large-format three-way touring line array element combining dual 12-inch woofers, quad 6-inch midranges and dual 1.4-inch HF drivers, all neodymium, for high power handling and SPL with an advanced flying-hardware concept.

  • Three-way line array: 2 x 12-inch + 4 x 6-inch + 2 x 1.4-inch HF

  • All-neodymium, high power handling

  • Advanced flying hardware, ground-cart deployable
Thumbnail:alt: Black line array speaker with gold MAG logo

Title: EX-HT3-4001-10
Sub Title: 4K60 HDBaseT 3.0 extender set
Product Description:
The Netvio EX-HT3-4001-10 is an HDBaseT 3.0 extender set built for the latest generation of long-distance 4K transmission. It delivers uncompressed 4K60 4:4:4 HDR video, full HDR support, Ethernet pass-through and bi-directional control over a single Cat6/6a cable for premium residential and commercial AV.

  • Powered by HDBaseT 3.0 – uncompressed 4K60 4:4:4, zero-latency video

  • HDR compatibility – HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, HLG

  • eARC/ARC audio return – Dolby Atmos, Dolby TrueHD, DTS-HD Master Audio

  • Transmission distance: 4K up to 40 m, 1080p up to 70 m over Cat6/6a

  • HDR: HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, HLG

  • Formats: LPCM, Dolby Digital/Plus/EX, Dolby TrueHD, DTS-HD Master Audio, DSD

  • Audio Embedding/De-embedding: Supported via L/R stereo and SPDIF

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.
Thumbnail:alt: NETVIO HDMI 2.0 extenders, one TX, one RX

Title: Phonix Flat
Sub Title: Slim-profile on-wall surround for 5.1, 7.1 and Atmos cinemas
Product Description:
Just 132mm deep, all the surround you need.

The Phonix Flat is a slim, flat-baffle home cinema surround speaker that puts you in the middle of the action. It works as a side, rear or ceiling effect speaker in 5.1, 7.1 and Dolby Atmos configurations and slips onto walls or ceilings with a low-profile bracket.

  • Only 132mm deep for unobtrusive installation

  • 165mm laminated polypropylene bass driver and 26mm doped fabric tweeter

  • 45Hz extension with 50-150W RMS handling for impactful soundtracks

Critically-damped cabinet and professional-grade crossover deliver smooth, non-fatiguing performance through long viewing sessions.
Thumbnail:alt: Black speaker with silver logo on white background

Title: EL-SC-350
Sub Title: Flagship rack-mount system controller with Z-Wave for demanding installations
Product Description:
The premium control center for the connected home.

The Nice EL-SC-350 is the premium control center for the connected home, bringing together all your intelligent devices to work as one seamless system. Control media, lighting, climate, pool/spa, irrigation, and more through a single app interface. As the flagship Nice controller, it gives you the ultimate flexibility for a system of virtually any size.

  • Extensive connectivity: RS-232, RS-485, Relays, IR, IP, input sensors and Z-Wave control

  • ARM big.LITTLE architecture integrating dual-core and quad-core processors

  • HDMI 2.0 for 4K 60Hz output with HDCP 1.4/2.2 support and H.265 decoding up to 4K

Built for any installation

  • Z-Wave control and automation of compatible devices built in

  • Single rack space form factor with rack mount hardware included

  • PoE ready and expandable with the EL-IO-200 Control Extender for large or decentralized installations

Consistent themes and layouts across Nice touch panels, remotes, and mobile apps deliver a multi-platform experience.

Title: SC-IC-SUB8
Sub Title: High-performance 8.27-inch small-aperture in-ceiling subwoofer with 4.75-inch opening
Product Description:
Best-in-class deep bass through a small, finished ceiling opening.

The SC-IC-SUB8 high-performance small-aperture in-ceiling subwoofer delivers best-in-class deep bass through a discreet 4.75" finished opening to meet the aesthetic needs of the modern home. The woofer cabinet hides between ceiling joists, porting low-frequency sound through the small opening. It features a custom 8.27" polypropylene woofer, dual 1.5" voice coils, a precision-tuned port tube, and a vinyl-wrapped MDF cabinet mounted to a single joist.

  • Custom 8.27" polypropylene cone maximized to the cabinet proportions

  • Dual voice coil for stereo wiring or single-channel use with included shorting bars

  • Analog filtering circuits with a 10 mH inductor per voice coil for deep, clear bass

  • 4.75" cut-out installs with a standard hole saw

Designed as a system

  • Engineered in the USA in tandem with the SC-IC3 speaker and SC4-100 amplifier

  • Delivers three-way, full-range sound optimized for aesthetics and flexibility

Simple single-joist mounting with integrated absorption pads reduces kinetic transmission through the structure.
Thumbnail:alt: Black exhaust vent with flexible ducting and adapter

Title: EX-HT2-701-10
Sub Title: 4K60 4:4:4 HDBaseT extender with ARC and Ethernet
Product Description:
The Netvio EX-HT2-701-10 is a long-reach HDBaseT extender set supporting 4K60 4:4:4 HDR over a single Cat6/6a cable, with Ethernet, ARC, PoC and bi-directional IR/RS-232 control. It is designed for residential and commercial AV runs where a full feature set and a single cable are critical.

  • PoC (Power over Cable) — one power supply for both units

  • Operating Temperature: 0–40°C / 32–104°F

  • Storage Temperature: –20–60°C / –4–140°F

  • Humidity: 20–90% RH (non-condensing)

18Gbps bandwidth, resolutions up to 4K@60Hz 4:4:4 with HDR10+, Dolby Vision & HLG

ARC (Audio Return Channel) with selectable SPDIF or L/R analog output

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.
Thumbnail:alt: Black Netvio HDMI extender with multiple ports.

Title: IW-50
Sub Title: D'Appolito 2-way in-wall speaker for music and home theatre
Product Description:
An exceptional soundstage, hidden in the wall.

The IW-50 is a discretely designed in-wall speaker that delivers an exceptional soundstage behind a magnetic grille. Configured as a D'Appolito 2-way array with dual 100mm bass drivers around a 26mm ring radiator tweeter, it works equally well for two-channel stereo and home theatre as front, centre or surround speakers.

  • Fully-enclosed rear cabinet keeps bass independent of wall cavity size

  • Wave-guide centre plug tweeter for controlled directivity

  • Fits standard 70mm stud walls with only 10mm gyprock depth required

Single-piece paintable stainless-steel grille available in white or black.
Thumbnail:alt: White in-wall speaker with black housing

Title: SA317
Sub Title:
2 way passive radiator
ACOUSTIC SOUND PANELS
Product Description:
The acoustic sound panels with integrated speaker CinemAtelier™ are part of the collection Architectural Acoustic Solution. The collection is the result of 15 years of constant acoustic innovation, aiming at offering the best acoustic comfort solution to any environment.

Tailor-made acoustic panels with integrated loudspeaker

CinemAtelier combines Atelier acoustic panels, a product of high-quality, Made in Italy manufacture, with the high fidelity of Garvan loudspeakers. The acoustic sound panels can be installed next to or under the TV and they feature integrated speakers, for a customised sound solution.

Tailor-made acoustic solutions for your TV

CinemAtelier™ panels are tailor-made, to perfectly adapt to the size of any kind of screen, guaranteeing an unparalleled acoustic and aesthetic result. Perfect integration and ease of installation are two fundamental elements distinguishing the collection.

Italian craftsmanship and high customisation possibilities

CinemAtelier™ acoustic sound panels are characterized by the excellent quality of Italian craftsmanship. The fabric covering the surface also covers the side surfaces and adds to the product a sartorial effect, particularly suitable for interior design. CinemAtelier™ is available in a wide range of finishes, colors, and custom graphics. The fireproof acoustic fabric in Trevira CS yarn offers a velvety tactile experience and is similar to cotton.

CinemAtelier™ allows reducing indoor noise and reverberation, thus offering the guests an improved and pleasant acoustic experience. Thanks to the soundproofing features of the panels combined with the high-quality sound of the integrated speakers, CinemAtelier™ will let you experience intense emotions like you were at the cinema.

Title: Seismix Transmitter
Sub Title: Wireless 24-bit transmitter for Krix Seismix subwoofers
Product Description:
Cut the cable, keep the resolution.

The Seismix Wireless Transmitter delivers uncompressed audio to compatible Krix subwoofers, letting you place the sub wherever it sounds best without running long cables back to the receiver.

  • Uncompressed transmission up to 192kHz / 24-bit, with no audible quality loss

  • Tri-band (2.4GHz, 5.2GHz, 5.8GHz) operation resists Wi-Fi interference

  • Pairs up to four subwoofers per transmitter with simple button-press setup

Compatible with Seismix 1 Mk6, Seismix 3 Mk7 and Seismix 3 DF Mk2. Low latency (20ms at 7m) keeps the LFE channel perfectly aligned with the rest of the system.
Thumbnail:alt: Black KRI X media box with digital display

Title: WASP-S15
Sub Title: Passive arrayable subwoofer
Product Description:
WASP has received the most advanced components to assist with the task of creating the ultimate compact line-array solution.
Thoroughly designed cabinets, the most advanced proprietary mounting system, and a wide selection of mounting and connectivity accessories were called in to provide the fast mounting/dismounting times, as well as ease of transportation and storage.
The WASP-S15 has been designed to be a reliable low-frequency support for the WASP line array. Based on a 15’’ LF woofer, the system delivers 137 dB of sound pressure. Featuring specifically designed integrated hardware, WASP-S15 can be used both in a stack or in a flown cluster.
Product description:
Passive arrayable subwoofer
Main features:

  • 1000 W nominal power

  • 15” woofer with 4” voice coil

  • 137 dB Peak SPL

  • Efficient hybrid horn design

  • Integrated flying hardware

Title: ISP ELITE
Sub Title: Immersive sound processor
Product Description:
Awarded multiple times as the best home cinema sound processor, the Elite can decode and upmix up to 32 channels while offering the capability to amplify up to 32 home cinema speakers. Just like all our products, it features the cutting-edge Dirac Live Active Room Treatment module.

We provide a range of options for a tailored and superior audio experience, including the addition of analog XLR outputs and support up to 32 AES/EBU and AoIP (AES67/Dante) channels.

Title: KA-1100
Sub Title: Dual-mono Class-D subwoofer amplifier with DSP for Krix subs
Product Description:
Silent, precision power for Krix subwoofers.

The KA-1100 is Krix's first dedicated subwoofer amplifier, built around ICEpower Class-D modules and a custom 24-bit DSP. It pairs perfectly with MX-5, MX-10, Cyclonix 11 and Cyclonix 12 subwoofers, delivering high output with vanishingly low distortion.

  • Three pre-configured DSP modes tuned for specific Krix subs, plus a general-purpose mode

  • Fan-less, silent operation with soft-limit protection for the drivers

  • Balanced and unbalanced inputs, 12V trigger, and removable rack ears for clean integration

With a brushed aluminium fascia and slim chassis, the KA-1100 disappears into furniture or racks while taking full command of your subwoofer stage.

Title: WAE121
Sub Title: ACTIVE SUBWOOFER
Product Description:
The WAE121 active subwoofer is designed to suit any environment with a natural and elegant style, thanks to the minimal design in steel and endless customisation possibilities in terms of colours and finishings. Unparalleled audio quality thanks to state-of-the-art components.

Minimal design and endless customisation possibilities

Timeless design and steel structure accompanied by various and elegant finishes, colours and customisations solutions.

Premium listening experience

We approach every aspect of the designing and building with the aim of delivering a superior sound performance: light sound, natural, relaxing, and realistic acoustic scene.  That’s why we only choose state-of-the-art electronic components. Our speakers are completely designed and manufactured in in Italy and are tested one by one.

Easy installation and superior versatility

Regardless of budget, size of the environment, type of mounting technology (wall, ceiling or on furniture or shelves), and listening experience and performances (stereo, multi-room, home theatre), [CORO] speakers represent the right solution for every need and are extremely easy to install.

Title: OWX-50
Sub Title: Compact on-wall cinema speaker with patented constant-directivity horn
Product Description:
Big cinema performance, small footprint.

The OWX-50 packs serious performance into a compact on-wall package. Its square baffle gives installers complete flexibility, working equally well as a screen, surround or overhead speaker without compromising acoustic behaviour.

  • Dual 165mm paper-cone drivers paired with a patented short-throw constant-directivity horn

  • Adjustable bracket mounts flush or angles up to 30 degrees to aim the speaker at the listening position

  • 97dB sensitivity and 50-500W RMS power handling for high-output cinema duty

Integrated grille and sleek, space-saving design make the OWX-50 a clean architectural fit in any room.

Title: B30g
Product Description:
B30g Invisible Subwoofer System (Legacy)

The B30g is a two-panel monaural invisible subwoofer system from Stealth's legacy LineaResponse line, superseded by the 8th-generation LR30W. Four acoustically coupled 8 in woofers (two per panel) deliver enhanced bass reinforcement for surround sound, home theater and whole-house audio systems, while the paintable face vanishes once finished.

  • Four 8 in woofers with 1-1/2 in voice coils across two panels

  • 20 Hz to 160 Hz frequency response

  • 100 watts RMS capacity, 60 watts minimum recommended

  • 86 dB sensitivity, 8 ohm nominal impedance

  • 170 degrees vertical and horizontal dispersion

  • Dimensions 15-7/8 in W x 30 in H per panel; 2-1/2 in mounting depth

The B30g remains a strong choice for adding invisible low-frequency output to existing LineaResponse installations.

Title: Stingray 83

The StingRay83 contains two independent protection circuits (low and high-frequency sections) that automatically reset upon reduction of excessive amplifier power.

StingRay speakers are known for raising the bar in outdoor audio durability and sound quality, and deliver smooth mid and high-frequency response with a solid, rich bass extension and are ideal for luxury residential, commercial, and marine applications. StingRay speakers combine direct coupled motor technology with an acoustic lever technology driven by a traditional woofer to energize the entire FidelityGlass™ active surface of the speaker panel resulting in crisp highs and impactful bass.

The sleek design and versatile mounting options mean the speakers won’t be an eyesore. To further enhance the aesthetic, Stealth offers custom finishing options so your speakers can Blend In! or Stand Out!

Title: SC3-IC8-DT
Sub Title: Premium Toolless Architectural Speaker
Product Description:
SC3-IC8-DT

8 Inch In-Ceiling Speaker With Black Kevlar Woofer, Dual Voice Coil And Dual Pivoting 1 1/4 Inch Aluminum Magnesium AccuAim Tweeters, Toolless Install

Introducing Nice Premium Toolless Speakers: 

Nice speakers are an evolution of SpeakerCraft™- the inventor of architectural speakers. Nice is proud to build upon this legacy, leveraging decades of expertise and innovation to produce some of the finest products on the market.
Technical Table:
Nice SC3 delivers outstanding performance and flexibility with six models, all featuring black Kevlar woofers, and 1.25 “aluminum magnesium tweeters, which are 56.3% larger than their 1” cousins. This results in more power at a lower crossover point, enhanced off-axis power response, and low- distortion. Kevlar is thin, stiff and light weight which improves transient response and dynamics, aluminum magnesium alloy has superior dampening properties, rigidity and strength- delivering impeccable detail. SC3 introduces a copper shorting ring (Faraday shield) into the design, which helps reduce distortion, improve efficiency while achieving a more consistent impedance across the frequency range. The asymmetrical crossover with a 3rd-order network encompassing 2nd-order LPF on woofer and 3rd-order HFP on the tweeter ensures superior integration between the woofer and tweeter. Compensation for inter driver time delay. A three- position tweeter level switch for fine tuning the high frequencies, and two position voice switch to allow fine tuning of the soundstage and vocal focus to taste. This combination is typical in high-end audiophile speakers, and yields an exceptional crisp, clear and dynamic musical performance. Nice Premium Toolless Speakers deliver elevated audio performance with advanced materials, toolless installation, and uncompromised design. Encompassing three levels of performance across 14 models, the series delivers a solution for most architectural speaker applications. From whole home music, and media rooms, to dedicated home theaters, and even high-moisture environments like outdoor patios or bathrooms. The speakers in each level are voiced to work coherently within the range delivering a complimentary balanced and dynamic sound across all applications throughout the home. The entire range boasts a suite of innovative features and benefits. Proprietary AccuAim technology enables precise, lockable tweeter positioning for enhanced phase accuracy, XmaG extended pole pieces for improved symmetry, meticulously engineered high-end crossovers for optimized driver performance, and time saving ViseLock™ designed by Swarm- the latest generation toolless system for rapid and secure installations- up to 75% faster!

AccuAim allows the tweeter to click-lock into a fixed angle that can be precisely replicated on other speakers in the system. This improves phase accuracy to pinpoint the sweet spot, and fine tune the soundstage.

ViseLock™ designed by Swarm, allows a rapid toolless install with the benefits of a patented clamping system of spring-loaded doglegs that snap into place instantly, securing the speaker. Thumb- levered cinches, lock and hold the installation for added stability- preventing spring sag for many years of service.

Go the extra mmTraditional pole pieces allow a magnetic gap in which the voice coil leaves the primary magnetic field resulting in non linier response and distortion, especially at higher levels.

XmaG precision pole piece extends significantly beyond the woofer’s voice coil travel path ensuring a consistent magnetic field- this results in a more linear response at all levels, lower distortion and clearer, more accurate sound reproduction. Lound AND Clear!

Metal is stronger than PlasticCustom designed metal frames are stiffer more, stable, with less transmission loss through the ceiling than typical injection molded frames.

Rust Resistant GrillsAll models include a paintable bezelless stainless-steel grill, which resists rust naturally. In-ceiling models include a round grill, with a square grill sold separately. In-wall models include a rectangular grill.

Product Description:
The acoustic sound panels with integrated speaker CinemAtelier™ are part of the collection Architectural Acoustic Solution. The collection is the result of 15 years of constant acoustic innovation, aiming at offering the best acoustic comfort solution to any environment.

Tailor-made acoustic panels with integrated loudspeaker

CinemAtelier combines Atelier acoustic panels, a product of high-quality, Made in Italy manufacture, with the high fidelity of Garvan loudspeakers. The acoustic sound panels can be installed next to or under the TV and they feature integrated speakers, for a customised sound solution.

Tailor-made acoustic solutions for your TV

CinemAtelier™ panels are tailor-made, to perfectly adapt to the size of any kind of screen, guaranteeing an unparalleled acoustic and aesthetic result. Perfect integration and ease of installation are two fundamental elements distinguishing the collection.

Italian craftsmanship and high customisation possibilities

CinemAtelier™ acoustic sound panels are characterized by the excellent quality of Italian craftsmanship. The fabric covering the surface also covers the side surfaces and adds to the product a sartorial effect, particularly suitable for interior design. CinemAtelier™ is available in a wide range of finishes, colors, and custom graphics. The fireproof acoustic fabric in Trevira CS yarn offers a velvety tactile experience and is similar to cotton.

CinemAtelier™ allows reducing indoor noise and reverberation, thus offering the guests an improved and pleasant acoustic experience. Thanks to the soundproofing features of the panels combined with the high-quality sound of the integrated speakers, CinemAtelier™ will let you experience intense emotions like you were at the cinema.

  • Optional wireless audio kit for flexible placement

Sub Station app and auto setup

Title: CCM12-MK3
Sub Title: 12-inch coaxial powered stage monitor
Product Description:
The CCM12-MK3 is a 12-inch bi-amped coaxial wedge monitor with presets for full-range and mid-high operation, an asymmetrical Class-D amplifier, 96kHz DSP and IP65-rated connectors.

  • 12-inch coaxial powered wedge monitor

  • 1200W asymmetrical Class-D (900W woofer / 300W HF)

  • 96kHz DSP; full-range and mid-high presets
