Title: Phonix
Sub Title: Wedge-shaped on-wall surround speaker for dedicated cinemas
Product Description:
Surround presence with cinema heritage.

The Phonix on-wall surround speaker carries a wedge-shaped enclosure derived from Krix's commercial cinema designs, optimised for high wall mounting with controlled pattern across the seating area.

  • 165mm bass driver with 33mm voice coil for low distortion at SPL

  • 26mm doped fabric dome tweeter for smooth, non-fatiguing highs

  • 45Hz low-frequency extension with 50-150W RMS handling

Available in Cinema Black, wood and Studio colour finishes, the Phonix is the natural surround partner for Krix's MX, Megaphonix and Cyclonix front stages.

Title: SC2-IC8
Sub Title: Series 2 8-inch toolless in-ceiling speaker for gaming and streaming
Product Description:
Bigger sound for immersive entertainment.

The Nice SC2-IC8 is a Series 2 premium toolless in-ceiling speaker that steps up to an 8 inch woofer for greater output and deeper low-end, ideal for immersive gaming, streaming, and distributed audio in larger spaces. Anodized ceramic/aluminum drivers deliver crisp, dynamic, crystal clear sound.

  • 8 inch anodized ceramic/aluminum woofer for room-filling output

  • 1 1/4 inch (30mm) anodized ceramic/aluminum dome tweeter lowers the crossover point for exceptional imagery

  • XMag longer pole piece ensures precise linearity and accurate reproduction

ViseLock toolless installation

  • ViseLock mounting system designed by Swarm enables installs up to 75% faster than conventional systems

  • Electroplated painted steel grill resists rust and is paintable to match any ceiling

Compatible with the optional FRBC-UNI 1-hour fire-rated cover. Backed by a 5 year warranty.

Title: Stingray 430
Sub Title: Environmentally Durable Sound
Product Description:
The Most Durable Outdoor Subwoofer

The StingRay430 is a high-powered, environ­mentally protected outdoor subwoofer system utilizing eight acoustically coupled, high-power, 8″ cone woofers (2 per side) to create space-filling, outdoor bass for frequency extension ranging from 20Hz to 100Hz.

Using acoustic lever principals, the StingRay430 provides exceptional bass output by trading excursion for surface area to generate bass.

Invisible Impervious Speakers

The StingRay430 subwoofer is raises the bar in outdoor audio durability and sound quality, delivering a smooth, rich bass extension. It is ideal for luxury residential, commercial, and marine applications. StingRay speakers and subwoofers combine direct coupled motor technology with an acoustic lever technology driven by a traditional woofer to energize the entire FidelityGlass™ active surface(s) of the speaker resulting in crisp highs and impactful bass.

The sleek design and black or white color option means the subwoofer won’t be an eyesore. To further enhance the aesthetic, Stealth offers custom finishing options so your subwoofer can Blend In! or Stand Out!

Title: L-RAD 116

Product Description:
2-Way 8th Generation Invisible Loudspeaker

The LineaRadiance 116 (LR116) is a compact, background music application invisible speaker. Its small footprint makes for easy installation into almost any location. It features a high-power, 6.5” cone woofer with one directly-coupled high-frequency driver.


LineaRadiance speakers are the 8th generation and next evolution of Stealth Acoustics’ LineaResponse flat radiating diaphragm speakers first released in 2003. Up to 5 new LineaRadiance speaker models are planned for release in 2024 for a full ‘family’ of 8th-generation invisible speaker/subwoofer offerings.

  • Integrated, acoustically tuned back box included with every speaker (removable)

  • New transducer/exciter driver designs

  • Increased overall efficiency

  • Fidelity Glass Advanced™ tuned and dampened fiber diaphragm

  • Easy-Tape™ tapered frame/diaphragm for improved finishing

  • Increased power handling

  • Re-voiced crossover networks

  • Increased overall diaphragm surface areas on many models

  • The new woofer mount for increased internal air volume

  • Improved poly-switches

  • New paper-finish diaphragm for better material adhesion

Title: SA214
Sub Title: 2 way ACOUSTIC SOUND PANELS
Product Description:
The acoustic sound panels with integrated speaker CinemAtelier™ are part of the collection Architectural Acoustic Solution. The collection is the result of 15 years of constant acoustic innovation, aiming at offering the best acoustic comfort solution to any environment.

  • ARC (Audio Return Channel) – routes TV audio back via SPDIF or L/R analog outputs

  • PoC (Power over Cable) – one power supply powers both units

  • On the Receiver (RX): The display is connected to the HDMI OUT, and if ARC is enabled on the display, the audio signal is sent back through the HDMI connection.

  • Over the HDBaseT Link: That return audio is transmitted from the RX to the TX.

  • On the Transmitter (TX): The ARC audio is output via the SPDIF optical port or 3.5mm stereo jack. It does not output through the HDMI port.

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.

Technical Table:
True Specifications

At BASSBOSS, with the MK3 line we have stopped using “Peak” and “RMS” power ratings for our amplifiers because those numbers alone are not an accurate representation of the real-world performance you can expect from our powered loudspeaker systems.

‍Peak Watts:

  • Essentially a theoretical maximum that the amplifiers could output for an instantaneous moment under ideal conditions with no load.

  • However, this peak power is not sustainable and has little practical relevance for how the loudspeakers will actually perform.

‍RMS (root mean square) Watts:

  • A measure of continuous power output, but even this figure doesn’t account for the true efficiency of how that power is converted into acoustic output by the transducers and overall speaker design.

  • The number of watts a loudspeaker “uses” is constantly fluctuating based on the impedance curve, frequency response, and heat generated in the voice coils.

  • Simply looking at how many watts an amplifier can produce on a test bench doesn’t translate to its real-world sound output capability.

‍What matters most is the complete integrated loudspeaker system and how efficiently it can convert the amplifier’s power into acoustic output while maintaining flat frequency response and headroom. Two loudspeakers with the same wattage ratings could have vastly different real-world sound pressure levels and clarity.

For these reasons, we believe wattage ratings alone are not a reliable metric. Listening tests and measurements of the overall system’s output capabilities like maximum SPL and distortion are far more telling than any peak or RMS wattage number viewed in isolation.

Our goal is to provide outstanding performance through intelligent system design, not just big wattage numbers.

Title: IP-JP4-60-DNT-RX-10
Sub Title: 4K60 4:4:4 AVoIP decoder with Dante audio
Product Description:
The Netvio IP-JP4-60-DNT-RX-10 is the Dante-AV-A audio-enabled AVoIP decoder in the JP4-60-DNT series. It delivers genuine 4K60 4:4:4 HDR video to an HDMI 2.0b display, accepts independent Dante audio routing, and is monitored through Dante Director and Domain Manager alongside Netvio360.

The decoder accepts uncompressed video over a standard 1 Gbps Ethernet link, drives a 4K HDMI 2.0b display, and supports video-wall, multiview, picture-in-picture and seamless fast-switching modes with sub-frame latency. The two Dante AV-A audio channels can be routed independently of video to break audio out to a Dante-enabled DSP or amplifier anywhere on the network. PoE powering means a single Cat6 cable provides both data and power back to the network switch, and ongoing configuration, monitoring and routing is handled from the Netvio360 console with end-user control delivered through NetvioGo.

Like the rest of the Netvio catalog the product is license-inclusive with the Netvio360 setup software, AppBuilder drag-and-drop GUI designer and the NetvioGo iOS / Android / Windows control app, and is designed for plug-and-play deployment by professional AV integrators.

Title: SC1-IC6-AW
Sub Title: Premium Toolless Architectural Speaker
Product Description:
SC1-IC6-AW

6.5 Inch In-Ceiling IP 66 All Weather Speaker With 6.5 Inch Injected Poly Woofer, Pivoting 1 Inch Silk AccuAim Tweeter and Toolless Install

Introducing Nice Premium Toolless Speakers: 

Nice speakers are an evolution of SpeakerCraft™- the inventor of architectural speakers. Nice is proud to build upon this legacy, leveraging decades of expertise and innovation to produce some of the finest products on the market.
Technical Table:
Innovative Solutions

Nice SC1

speakers are optimized for high quality ambient music, and everyday media applications throughout the home. With 6.5” injected polypropylene woofers and 1” silk dome tweeters. There are four models including down firing, fixed-tilt, dual tweeter, and all weather in-ceiling speakers. The symmetrical 2nd-order crossover network provides quality, consistency and reliability. Nice Premium Toolless Speakers deliver elevated audio performance with advanced materials, toolless installation, and uncompromised design. Encompassing three levels of performance across 14 models, the series delivers a solution for most architectural speaker applications. From whole home music, and media rooms, to dedicated home theaters, and even high-moisture environments like outdoor patios or bathrooms. The speakers in each level are voiced to work coherently within the range delivering a complimentary balanced and dynamic sound across all applications throughout the home. The entire range boasts a suite of innovative features and benefits. Proprietary AccuAim technology enables precise, lockable tweeter positioning for enhanced phase accuracy, XmaG extended pole pieces for improved symmetry, meticulously engineered high-end crossovers for optimized driver performance, and time saving ViseLock™ designed by Swarm- the latest generation toolless system for rapid and secure installations- up to 75% faster!

AccuAim allows the tweeter to click-lock into a fixed angle that can be precisely replicated on other speakers in the system. This improves phase accuracy to pinpoint the sweet spot, and fine tune the soundstage.

ViseLock™ designed by Swarm,allows a rapid toolless install with the benefits of a patented clamping system of spring-loaded doglegs that snap into place instantly, securing the speaker. Thumb- levered cinches, lock and hold the installation for added stability- preventing spring sag for many years of service.

Go the extra mmTraditional pole pieces allow a magnetic gap in which the voice coil leaves the primary magnetic field resulting in non linier response and distortion, especially at higher levels.

XmaGprecision pole piece extends significantly beyond the woofer’s voice coil travel path ensuring a consistent magnetic field- this results in a more linear response at all levels, lower distortion and clearer, more accurate sound reproduction. Lound AND Clear!
Metal is stronger than Plastic

Custom designed metal frames are stiffer more, stable, with less transmission loss through the ceiling than typical injection molded frames.

Rust Resistant GrillsAll models include a paintable bezelless stainless-steel grill, which resists rust naturally. In-ceiling models include a round grill, with a square grill sold separately. In-wall models include a rectangular grill.

Technical Table:
True Specifications

At BASSBOSS, with the MK3 line we have stopped using “Peak” and “RMS” power ratings for our amplifiers because those numbers alone are not an accurate representation of the real-world performance you can expect from our powered loudspeaker systems.

Peak Watts:

  • Essentially a theoretical maximum that the amplifiers could output for an instantaneous moment under ideal conditions with no load.

  • However, this peak power is not sustainable and has little practical relevance for how the loudspeakers will actually perform.

‍RMS (root mean square) Watts:

  • A measure of continuous power output, but even this figure doesn’t account for the true efficiency of how that power is converted into acoustic output by the transducers and overall speaker design.

  • The number of watts a loudspeaker “uses” is constantly fluctuating based on the impedance curve, frequency response, and heat generated in the voice coils.

  • Simply looking at how many watts an amplifier can produce on a test bench doesn’t translate to its real-world sound output capability.

What matters most is the complete integrated loudspeaker system and how efficiently it can convert the amplifier’s power into acoustic output while maintaining flat frequency response and headroom. Two loudspeakers with the same wattage ratings could have vastly different real-world sound pressure levels and clarity.

For these reasons, we believe wattage ratings alone are not a reliable metric. Listening tests and measurements of the overall system’s output capabilities like maximum SPL and distortion are far more telling than any peak or RMS wattage number viewed in isolation.

Our goal is to provide outstanding performance through intelligent system design, not just big wattage numbers.

Sub Title: On-wall cinema speaker with adjustable 45deg angled baffle
Product Description:
Aim the sound, lose the EQ.

The Phonix 45 is a versatile on-wall and ceiling-mountable surround speaker designed for dedicated cinemas. Its adjustable angled baffle lets installers point output directly at the listening position, optimising high-frequency response without heavy equalisation.

  • Shallow 124mm depth fits walls, ceilings and corners

  • 50-150W RMS handling with 45Hz low-frequency extension

  • 165mm polypropylene bass driver and ferro-fluid-cooled 26mm doped fabric tweeter

Supplied with a fully adjustable bracket and black cloth grille, the Phonix 45 is Australian-made and at home in any immersive cinema layout.

Title: EL-HR40

The HR40 Remote Control is a full-fledged control interface that lets you answer the front door with video, view surveillance cameras, or communicate with other interfaces using intercom, all from a 3.1" high resolution touchscreen. With swipe, scroll and touch controls, the HR40 is intuitive and provides an unparalleled user experience for control of media, lighting, climate, security, surveillance, and more.

  • 3.1" LED backlit capacitive touchscreen with 480 x 800 resolution

  • Integrated intercom and video doorbell answering plus surveillance monitoring

  • Integrated voice control and backlit buttons that wake on motion or button press

Built for easy deployment

  • Wi-Fi connectivity for extended range and wireless configuration

  • Direct IR control without IR emitter cables and a remote finder feature

  • Magnetic charging base securely holds the remote in place

Wirelessly configured and personalized with interface templates, the HR40 can be quickly added to any Nice system for the most intuitive control.

Title: C15i
Sub Title:
15" long throw woofer
18mm plywood cabinet
Bass reflex design
Get it in black or white
Product Description:
High output passive subwoofer

C15i is a subwoofer designed for custom installation in rooms over 80 sqm. in in- and semi outdoor applications. The reflex loaded cabinet features a 15” woofer with an advanced motor. The 75 mm Ø aluminum voice coil employs the interleaved sandwich voice coil with windings on both the outer and inner surfaces to achieve a mass- balanced coil. The results in a linear motor with excellent control and very low distortion even at maximum output. The magnetic structure has been optimized using FEA CAD resource that maximized the flux density in the voice coil gap for optimized clarity. Excellent heat dissipation has also been achieved by incorporating air channels between the basket and the magnetic top plate reducing power compression significantly and thereby improving dynamics. C15i is designed to be driven by the Cornered DSP amplifiers.

The most advanced implementation of Dirac Live Active Room Treatment ensures accurate calibration, while up to 20 PEQs per channel, four-way active crossovers and unlimited subwoofer support give integrators full control over even the most ambitious systems.

Title: ISP Elite MK3
Sub Title: REFERENCE IMMERSIVE SOUND PROCESSOR
Product Description:
Description

The ISP Elite MK3 is StormAudio's reference immersive sound processor — a modular, future-proof platform that took 'Best New Home Cinema Sound Processor of 2022' and continues to set the bar. Engineered around a software-defined hardware strategy, every major subsystem (HDMI, audio outputs, processing) is upgradeable, so the chassis you install today keeps pace with format and connectivity changes for years.

Up to 24 channels of decoding and upmixing — and up to 32 channels of post-processing — handle Dolby Atmos, DTS:X Pro, Auro-3D and IMAX Enhanced. Seven HDMI inputs with HDMI 2.1a / HDCP 2.3 support 8K at 40 Gbps and full HDR10+, Dolby Vision and HLG pass-through.

The full Dirac Live suite — Live, Bass Control, Bass Management and Active Room Treatment (DLART) — comes standard, with model variants delivering 16, 24 or 32 analog XLR channels, or 32 digital AES/EBU or AoIP (AES67/Dante) outputs for the most ambitious installations.

Title: PA 8 Ultra MK3
Sub Title: 8-CHANNEL POWER AMPLIFIER
Product Description:
Description

It is the heart of an immersive system, pumping 200 W per channel into 8 ohms or 400 W into 4 ohms across all eight channels.

When bigger SPLs or LCR/subwoofer duty calls, four bridged BTL channels deliver up to 800 W RMS at 8 ohms with 32 dB of gain. THD+N is held below 0.005% at 1 W and signal-to-noise sits at 115 dB, with frequency response extending from 10 Hz to 50 kHz (-3 dB CEM).

Ethernet remote monitoring via StormMonitoring, USB service access and 12 V triggers tie it cleanly into any StormAudio ISP-based system.

Title: FLY-R60
Sub Title: High-output passive line array module (R series)
Product Description:
FLY-R60 is a potent passive line array solution featuring four 6.5 in woofers and two 1.4 in high-frequency transducers. Engineered for short to medium-throw applications, delivering 70 degrees horizontal coverage with a 0 degree vertical splay angle for controlled dispersion. Sub Title: High-output passive line array module, wider coverage

FLY-R68 is engineered for short and medium-throw applications, featuring four 6.5 in woofers and two 1.4 in high-frequency drivers. It delivers 110 degrees horizontal coverage with an 8 degree vertical splay angle, providing tightly controlled dispersion and high intelligibility.

FLY-R8B is a passive cardioid subwoofer engineered for concert halls, theaters, and clubs. A unique six-driver configuration with four front-firing and two rear-firing 8 in woofers achieves up to -16 dB rear cancellation, reducing stage noise and focusing sound toward the audience.

Title: MX-20 Mk2
Sub Title: Modular cinema LCR system for compact dedicated theatres
Product Description:
Modular cinema, refined for the mid-size theatre.

The MX-20 Mk2 brings even greater power, clarity and control to compact dedicated cinemas, with a new 12-inch mid-bass driver and a high-output compression driver behind Krix's patented constant-directivity horn. Five slim modules of matched height install behind acoustically transparent screens to give every seat the same dynamic, articulate presentation.

  • 2-way LCR modules with 95dB sensitivity and 100-700W RMS handling

  • 15-inch subwoofer modules with 96dB sensitivity and reversible cabinet orientation

  • Acoustic-absorbent front baffles reduce screen reflections and lift dialogue clarity

Designed for rooms 4-7 metres deep with 105" (16:9) or 130" (21:9) minimum screens.
Thumbnail:alt: Five black modular speakers with perforated fronts.

Title: MX-30i
Sub Title: Modular cinema LCR with infra-bass subwoofers for medium to large rooms
Product Description:
Cinematic accuracy, right into the seat.

The MX-30i builds on Krix's award-winning MX-30 with new high-performance subwoofer modules that take low-frequency reproduction into true infrasonic territory. Designed for medium to large dedicated cinemas with acoustically transparent screens, it delivers movie soundtracks with supreme definition all the way through the picture.

  • 15-inch LCR modules with patented 90 deg x 40 deg horn, 98dB sensitivity and 100-700W RMS handling

  • 18-inch DSP-controlled subwoofer modules extending to 15Hz (-3dB) and 10Hz with DSP

  • Five matched, slim-line modules drop into a single cavity for clean installation

Recommended for rooms 5-14m deep with screens from 135" (16:9) or 130" (21:9).

Title: MX-40i
Sub Title: Reference 3-way modular LCR with infra-bass for premium cinemas
Product Description:
Reference cinema, evolved.

The MX-40i is the flagship modular system in Krix's dedicated cinema range, pairing the acclaimed MX-40 3-way bi-amped LCR modules with new infrasonic subwoofer modules for medium to large theatres. Engineered for acoustically transparent screens, it delivers astonishing dynamic range with precision across the whole seating area.

  • 3-way bi-amped LCR modules with patented 90 deg x 40 deg dual horn array

  • 18-inch DSP-controlled subwoofer modules extending to 13Hz (-6dB)

  • Five slim, matched modules for clean cavity installation

Best suited to rooms 5-14m deep with 135" (16:9) or larger screens, and DSP-amplified subwoofer channels.

Title: MXi-118
Sub Title: 18-inch infra-bass module for MX-30 and MX-40 cinema systems
Product Description:
Hear and feel the lowest octave.

The MXi-118 is a dedicated infra-bass module designed to integrate with existing MX-30 and MX-40 systems, taking low-frequency power and extension into true infrasonic territory for impact you can both hear and feel.

  • Single 460mm (18") treated paper cone with 100mm voice coil for high excursion

  • 10Hz-200Hz (with DSP), 15Hz at -3dB, 13Hz at -6dB

  • Reversible cabinet with dual terminals to suit any room layout

Sub Title: Sealed dual 18-inch infra-bass subwoofer for dedicated cinemas
Product Description:
Effortless infra-bass, mechanically silent.

The UCX-218 is a premium sealed subwoofer engineered for deep infra-bass performance. Dual 18-inch high-excursion drivers run in an opposing configuration that cancels unwanted mechanical vibration, leaving only clean, articulate bass.

  • 10Hz extension with DSP; 15Hz at -3dB and 13Hz at -6dB

  • 50mm peak-to-peak driver displacement for tactile impact at any seat

  • Cabinet can be installed vertically or horizontally to suit the room

Recommended amplification is 2 x 1500-3000W @ 4 Ohms (or 1 x 3000-6000W @ 2 Ohms paralleled), driven through Krix's proprietary high-current binding posts.

The right finish for great-sounding gear.

Title: IC-80
Sub Title: Dual-concentric in-ceiling speaker for home theatre and outdoor use
Product Description:
As at home outdoors as in the theatre.

The IC-80 (Stratospherix AS) is a high-output dual-concentric in-ceiling speaker engineered for both home theatre and outdoor entertaining. A 200mm bass driver and 45mm compression tweeter deliver powerful, uniform coverage in all directions.

  • IP54 weather-resistant rating with rust-resistant stainless steel grille

  • Semi-enclosed back box maintains consistent bass extension

  • 93dB sensitivity with 20-200W RMS handling for serious SPL

An ideal choice when alfresco areas, pool decks and home theatres need to share one tough, great-sounding speaker.

Sub Title: Weather-resistant 10-inch coaxial installation speaker

10-inch coaxial install speaker, weatherised

The AIR-CX10 IP is a passive 10-inch coaxial loudspeaker engineered for balanced output, clarity and even coverage in medium installations. Its conical dispersion pattern works equally well in vertical or horizontal orientation, and the IP54 enclosure carries that performance outdoors.

  • 10-inch coaxial driver with 2.5-inch voice coil

Title: AIR-CX12 IP
Sub Title: Weather-resistant 12-inch coaxial installation speaker
Product Description:
12-inch coaxial install speaker for outdoor and indoor use

The AIR-CX12 IP is a passive 12-inch coaxial loudspeaker for medium to large installations, with conical 90 x 90 dispersion and a weather-resistant enclosure rated to IP54. Pan-tilt U-brackets and VESA 100 x 100 mounting open up wall, ceiling, vertical and horizontal orientations.

  • 12-inch coaxial driver with 2.5-inch voice coil

  • 300 W nominal power, 121 dB Max SPL, 97 dB sensitivity

  • 90° x 90° conical coverage in any orientation

  • 4 / 8 / 16 Ohm install-friendly impedance options

  • Available in black or white finishes

The AIR-CX12 IP sits between the CX10 and CX15 for projects needing more headroom than a 10-inch can deliver while keeping the same dispersion and install footprint - clubs, restaurants, retail, lobbies and outdoor terraces.

Sub Title: Weather-resistant 15-inch coaxial installation speaker
Product Description:
15-inch coaxial install speaker, all-weather

The AIR-CX15 IP is the largest member of the AIR-CX coaxial install family, built around a 15-inch coaxial driver in an IP54 cabinet. Its 90 x 90 conical pattern provides smooth coverage from short throws to medium-throw installation environments.

  • 300 W nominal power, 122 dB Max SPL, 98 dB sensitivity

  • 50 - 18,000 Hz frequency response (-10 dB)

  • 4 / 8 / 16 Ohm impedance for flexible install wiring

  • VESA 100 x 100, 8 x M10 mounts and an M10 safety point

The CX15 IP is the choice when a single coaxial cabinet has to cover bigger areas with extended low end and full-range tone - large clubs, gyms, sports venues, atriums and outdoor stage-side fills.

BX MDF Back Box

Title: Ci2
Sub Title: Ultra-compact 2-way IP65 commercial install speaker
Product Description: The Cornered Audio Ci2 is an ultra-compact 2-way commercial installation speaker designed for background sound in coffee shops, hotels, retail spaces and similar small commercial rooms. Like the rest of the Ci range it uses Cornered's patented triangular ABS cabinet so it can sit flush in a corner or on a wall or ceiling without any visible bracket. The cabinet is IP65 rated for both indoor and outdoor use, the speaker terminal is hidden inside the cabinet for a clean finish, and the compact 2 1/2-inch woofer with 3/4-inch dome tweeter delivers a surprising amount of clear, even output for a speaker of its size. The Ci2 is sold through commercial AV distribution channels and is well-suited to projects that need many small, discreet speakers to cover an open public space.
Thumbnail:alt: Two white corner speakers on a white background.

Title: Ci4
Sub Title: Compact 2-way IP65 commercial install speaker
Product Description: The Cornered Audio Ci4 is a feature-packed compact 2-way full-range commercial install speaker. It pairs a 4-inch woofer with a 4-inch passive slave and a 1-inch silk dome tweeter inside Cornered's patented triangular ABS cabinet, so it can be flush-mounted into a corner, on a wall or on a ceiling without any visible bracket. The IP65 rating makes it equally happy indoors and outdoors, and a switchable tweeter protection circuit safeguards the high-frequency driver against accidental overload from the amplifier. Cabinets can be coupled together to widen the coverage pattern to 180, 270 or 360 degrees for open-plan spaces. The Ci4 is the 8-ohm low-impedance version and is intended for cafes, hotels, shops and other medium-sized commercial venues.

Title: Ci4-V
Sub Title: Ci4 with switchable 70 V / 100 V transformer
Product Description: The Cornered Audio Ci4-V is the high-impedance version of the popular Ci4 commercial install speaker. It has the same compact triangular ABS cabinet, IP65 rating and switchable tweeter protection as the standard Ci4, but adds an integrated step-down transformer with front-baffle tap settings of 3.5, 7.5, 15 or 30 watts and a switch to revert to standard 8-ohm operation. That makes it a drop-in fit for 70 V or 100 V distributed-audio backbones in restaurants, retail, hotels and similar venues, while still offering the option of low-impedance operation if the installer adds an amplifier per zone. Cabinets can be coupled together for 180, 270 or 360 degree coverage of larger open-plan rooms.

The cabinet flush-mounts into a corner or onto a wall or ceiling without any visible bracket, the speaker terminal is hidden inside the cabinet for a clean finish, and a switchable tweeter protection circuit guards the high-frequency driver. Cabinets can be coupled together to widen coverage to 180, 270 or 360 degrees for larger open-plan spaces. The Ci5 is the 8-ohm low-impedance version, suited to venues that drive each zone with its own amplifier.

Title: CS352-ADSP
Product Description:
The LEA Professional CS352-ADSP is a 2-channel Network CONNECT Series smart amplifier delivering 350 watts per channel at 4Ω, 8Ω, 70V, and 100V (175W at 2Ω). The "ADSP" designation indicates the Advanced DSP variant, upgrading the platform to an Analog Devices Sharc 96kHz processor with linear-phase FIR crossover filters at up to 2,048 taps per channel for superior phase coherence and transparency — making it ideal for high-performance live, install, and hi-fi applications.

Three ways to connect — built-in Wi-Fi access point, existing Wi-Fi, or FAST Ethernet — combined with the LEA CONNECT cloud platform, browser-based WebUI, and third-party APIs allow integrators to configure, monitor, and service the amplifier from anywhere in the world with no VPN required.
